name: LightGaussian Pruning Scoring
definition: A 2D projection-based primitive scoring method that ranks primitives for pruning based on accumulated ray contributions across multiple synthesized views, utilizing view-dependent features like ray hits and transmittance.
summary: LightGaussian Pruning Scoring ranks 3D Gaussian primitives for removal by accumulating ray contributions across multiple synthesized views, differing from volume-based methods by operating in image space.
